name: Chorus of the Lost
summary: 15-ft Sphere at 60 ft, Wis save: 2d6 Psychic and Frightened for the spell (save ends each turn); a success halves the damage and Frightens only to the end of its next turn.
text: You call up the eerie song and wailing of lost souls from a point you can see within 60 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure the target takes 2d6 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition for the duration. On a success it takes half as much damage and is Frightened only until the end of its next turn. A Frightened target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. The silver bell (worth at least 10 GP) is not consumed. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2.
